review_scope: Text-only independent semantic review of the complete R04 body extraction (P001–P196, TABLES T01–T18, §1–§12), targeting the four special-attention items: (1) §9.2 1–5 distribution, (2) REP-0121-004-RATE / REP-0121-DIST-01 in both the in-document register and the reproduced CSV, (3) coherence of carried-forward content, (4) mapping/genre/usability/negative neighbors/fabrication. No DOCX binary, rendering, or visual layout was opened (separate exact-SHA native Word receipts cover that). The R03 extract is not in the packet, so R03 coherence was verified against the complete current body plus the repair receipt change list, not a direct diff. Semantic PASS is not formal acceptance.
limitations: Text-only semantic review of the extracted body; the DOCX binary, native Word rendering, pagination, fonts and visual layout were not opened or inspected — those are covered by the separate exact-SHA native Word receipts cited in the packet.

Cryptographic identities (candidate DOCX SHA-256, extract SHA-256, native PDF SHA-256, register CSV SHA-256 8e95ca7e…, official PDF/seed hashes) are asserted by the packet and echoed here; none were recomputed in this read-only review, and the review itself is only meaningful if the packet body truly derives from the stated exact SHAs and review receipt is later bound to them.

The external register CSV was verified against its full reproduction in the packet and against the in-document register row-for-row (23/23 rows match, including REP-0121-004-RATE and REP-0121-DIST-01 with all five required elements); on-disk byte/SHA equality with the CSV could not be checked from inside the packet.

The R03 extraction is not included; 'all original R03 content remains coherent' was verified by recomputing the complete current body and checking the three declared R03→R04 changes against it, not by a direct text diff against R03.
All statistics were independently recomputed by this reviewer from the line-item tables in the body (T07, T10, T11); every displayed figure reproduced exactly, including the new distribution.
A semantic PASS is not formal association acceptance; formal acceptance remains NOT_GRANTED and real evidence remains UNKNOWN/HOLD until the Human Gate.
